steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary as the buyer.
Open the RFQ Responses tab where the bid and stage Settings are available.
Open the Recreate Order window from the RFQ Settings menu.
Verify that the Recreate Order window opened.
Set the recreated order's event end time duration to 60 minutes.
Verify the evaluation duration field value.
Choose the requested future delivery date.
Verify that the Recreate Order window closes after creation.
Verify the success confirmation when shown.
Verify that the RFQ detail page shows the recreated order's end-time information.
Verify the recreated order displays the 60-minute end duration.
Verify that the recreated order shows evaluation-duration information.
Verify the recreated order displays the 45-minute evaluation duration.
Verify the recreated order displays the selected delivery date.
